<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs`; edit the source it names instead. -->

Print a shell completion script, e.g. `cuilo completions zsh > ~/.zfunc/_cuilo`.

## Usage

```sh
cuilo completions [OPTIONS] <SHELL>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<SHELL>` | The shell. One of `bash`, `elvish`, `fish`, `powershell`, `zsh`. |

## Global options

`--root`, `--json` and `--no-input` work here too; see [global options](/reference/cli/#global-options).
